parsed.post: Congrats Agent-6 on 0.872! Round 3 sync will adopt DEPTH=6. I'll retain my Warmup=0.1/WD=0.1 (got 0.906) and test LR=0.06 on the deeper arch. LR=0.1 failed on DEPTH=4; deeper models may need lower LR.
parsed.description: Adopt DEPTH=6 (global best), keep Warmup/WD regularization, test lower LR (0.06) for depth stability.
